chrome_web_store.summary: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok to local Herdr workspaces.
chrome_web_store.description:
Herdr connects ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok to local Herdr workspaces.

CONTROL CENTER
• Bind the current Project or conversation to a Herdr workspace.
• See live workspaces, panes, and agents in the Chrome Side Panel.
• Send trusted local Agent prompts through Chrome Native Messaging.

CONTINUITY
• Wake the bound Web AI when local work changes or settles so the Web planner can inspect, integrate, and verify the result.
• Queue a next-turn message, preserve bounded long-conversation state, and use safe handoff when needed.
• 429 responses back off; uncertain mutations are not blindly replayed.

LOCAL SECURITY
• Native Messaging reaches the local herdr-mcp runtime over trusted local IPC.
• Herdr bearer credentials are not stored in page scripts or browser storage.
• No remote code is loaded.

SITE ACCESS
• ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok are supported by default.
• chat.z.ai, chat.deepseek.com, and Gemini are experimental and disabled by default.

Install Herdr and herdr-mcp first, then run `herdr-mcp native-host install`.
chrome_web_store.single_purpose: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok to the user's local Herdr workspaces for workspace binding, live local status, trusted WebChat control, continuity, and bounded recovery in the Chrome Side Panel.
chrome_web_store.review_notes: Install the matching herdr-mcp runtime and run `herdr-mcp native-host install`. Open ChatGPT, Claude, or Grok and the Herdr Side Panel. All three supported WebChat origins are included in the extension's required host permissions. Project and Project-chat pages expose workspace binding plus WebChat Control; global new-chat/home pages expose WebChat Control without a workspace binding. z.ai, DeepSeek, and Gemini are experimental and OFF by default. No remote code is loaded.
